Description: 1. The subject of the contract includes, in particular: 1) conducting an on-site inspection of the installation site for the system for receiving and processing data from polar-orbiting satellites, as well as presenting detailed conditions for the preparation by the Contracting Authority of the infrastructure necessary for the system installation; 2) supply, installation, configuration, and commissioning of a system consisting of: a. a receiving antenna with data reception components such as a feedhorn, converter, cabling, antenna control system, b. a receiver/demodulator compatible with the antenna, c. computer hardware for data processing, d. software; 3) granting/supply of software licences; 4) conducting system tests and commissioning the system for operational use 5) supply of the system’s technical documentation 6) conducting training for system users and administrators; 7) granting a warranty and providing technical support services of one year from the date of signing the final acceptance protocol. 2.
